# Project Agent Instructions ## Git handoff * After making project changes, always include the relevant Git commands the user can run to stage, commit, and push those changes. * Tailor the staging command to the files changed in the task; do not blindly stage unrelated working-tree changes. * Do not run, recommend, or include `git diff` commands.
* Do not commit or push unless the user explicitly asks the agent to do so. * Treat every push as a synchronized push: first pull the current remote branch with rebase, then push that same branch. * When handing off push commands, include both the synchronization pull and the subsequent push; do not provide a standalone `git push` command. * every PowerShell command block provided will include an extra blank line after the final command—effectively an additional Enter at the end—so the last command is ready to execute when pasted
